
go env GKBIN
stdout $WORK${/}gopath${/}bin
go env -changed GKBIN
! stdout $WORK

# report explicit settings
env GKBIN=/tmp/gobin
go env GKBIN
stdout /tmp/gobin
go env -changed GKBIN
stdout /tmp/gobin

# reset
env GKBIN=
go env -changed GKBIN
! stdout $WORK

# In GKPATH mode
# the default install directory depends on the GKPATH
# technically it also depends on the install target
# but that's not something we can report.
env GK111MODULE=off
env GKPATH=$WORK${/}a${:}$WORK${/}b

# report GKPATH[0]/bin outside of GKPATH
cd $WORK
go env GKBIN
stdout $WORK${/}a${/}bin

# report the current GKPATH/bin inside of a GKPATH
cd $WORK/a/src/example1.com
go env GKBIN
stdout $WORK${/}a${/}bin

cd $WORK/b/src/example2.com
go env GKBIN
stdout $WORK${/}b${/}bin

-- $WORK/a/src/example1.com/main.go --
package main

-- $WORK/b/src/example2.com/main.go --
package main
